# GSAP 3.15.0

Core and ScrollTrigger are unmodified files from the official `gsap@3.15.0` npm package. The package SHA-512 was verified before extraction. Copyright and license headers are preserved.

GSAP is third-party software under the [GSAP Standard License](https://gsap.com/standard-license/), not the theme's GPL license. Free commercial website use does not imply unrestricted permission to distribute a competing visual animation authoring tool.

The planned Lieve visual animation builder requires a product-specific license review and, where applicable, written permission before distribution. This development integration does not establish that permission. No remote CDN or telemetry is used.
